services.name: Sunrise Paddle Club
services.desc: About Get active at sunrise with a guided paddleboard from Jericho beach! This program is designed for those who have experience paddleboarding but are looking for motivation to get out on the water in an organized way. Every week, one of our experienced paddleboarding instructors will guide the group out onto the ocean as the rays of the sun start to bounce off the water at dawn. All you need to worry about is bringing a towel & bathing suit - we’ll take care of the rest. Challenge your core, improve your balance, and make a morning paddleboard part of your weekly workout routine by signing up today! services.name: Discover Windsurfing I
services.desc: About Seen those people with board and sail contraptions whizzing around English Bay? Not quite sailers but also not quite surfers... As the first school in Western Canada (est. 1977), you've come to the right place to learn how to windsurf! Over the course of this 3 hour lesson, learn the basics of this unique sport, including: the history of windsurfing, equipment knowledge, points of sail/ wind theory, steering, tacking, water and marine environment safety. You will spend time both on land and on the water. This course is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to the sport of windsurfing.
